 Job Description
 Skills Needed:
 Proven experience with PowerBI .
Strong SQL/p-SQL/pl-SQL/T-SQL skills. 
Exposure to AWS or Azure cloud data services. 
General understanding of ETL, relational databases, warehousing and reporting techniques
 Nice to have:
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Data Factory, Redshift, Athena, Aurora
 Understanding of complex Tableau calculation, LOD, Parameters, Set, Groups and their equivalent in Power BI and Power BI, MOM/YOY Analysis
Knowledge of NoSQL databases. 
Familiarity with Python, Spark, and Scala. 
Experience with SAP objects / BI. 
 Responsibilities:
 Utilize Power BI or Tableau or Qlik for additional reporting and visualization requirements. 
 Develop and maintain ETL processes to ensure data quality and consistency. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
